How Sakura Works

Launch, trade, graduate — fair from the first second.

Watch the intro

Two minutes — every feature, end to end.

1

Create in 1 transaction

Name it, add a logo, launch. The full fixed supply of 1 billion tokens lands on the bonding curve and trading starts instantly. Launch fee: 0.0005 LOOP.

2

Trade on the curve

Buy and sell on the curve — the price rises with every buy and falls with every sell. Anti-snipe: a 99% buy tax in the first second decays to 0% within ±5 seconds, so bots can't front-run you.

3

Graduate to Uniswap

At 75 LOOP the token graduates automatically. Liquidity moves to Uniswap and is locked forever — no one can pull it, not even the creator.

The Bonding Curve, in Plain Words

Think of a glass filling with water. Early buys are cheap because the curve is nearly empty. Every buy fills it a little more and pushes the price up. Hit the dashed line — 75 LOOP — and the token graduates to Uniswap.

Fixed supply1 Billion / token
Graduation target75 LOOP
Trade fee1% · 70% to creator
Anti-snipe99% → 0% in ±5 sec

Transparent Fees

Token creation fee0.0005 LOOP
Fee on every trade1%
↳ To the token creator70% of the fee
↳ To the Sakura protocol30% of the fee
Creator tax (locked at launch)0–3% — curve + pool
Pool fee after graduation (new tokens)0.3% per swap
↳ To LPs — claimable anytime0.10%
↳ To the token creator (or its fee pot)0.05% + creator tax
↳ To the Sakura platform0.15%

New tokens graduate to the claim stack: each swap pays 0.3% — 0.10% to LPs (claimable anytime; it does not compound in the pool), 0.05% to the creator, 0.15% to the platform — plus the creator tax (0–3%, locked at launch), which is charged on curve and pool trades alike. For Buyback & Burn and Holders tokens, the creator’s share and the tax go to the token’s fee pot instead — the creator receives 0. Claim creator fees in Profile. Older pairs keep their original models: corrected pairs split 0.10% pool / 0.05% creator / 0.15% platform, fee-split pairs 0.20% pool / 0.05% creator / 0.05% platform, and the oldest pairs keep the full 0.3% in the pool.

Where the fees go: the protocol’s 30% accrues to the Treasury. The creator’s share follows each token’s fee destination, locked at launch — fee-wallet tokens pay it, and the creator tax, to the creator; Buyback & Burn and Holders tokens send it all to the token’s fee pot, and the creator receives 0.

SupplyFixed 1,000,000,000
NetworkEVM

Built EVM-agnostic — the same contracts can deploy to Base, BNB Chain, and Ethereum.

Anti-Rug by Design

Three rules built into every Sakura token.

LP Locked Forever

Liquidity is locked forever after graduation. No withdraw button — for anyone.

No Sneaky Functions

No hidden mint. No wallet freeze. No blacklist. No hidden taxes.

Anti-Snipe 99% → 0%

First-second bots pay a 99% tax that decays within ±5 seconds. Everyone else trades normally.
